gen-gf-happy-monkey-fs-synonym: Synonym lays down a plain sans line of constant ink, with curves that open generously. And Happy Monkey's ruler-straight strokes and wide-gapped e give the headline a bold, distinctive swagger above it.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-outfit: Outfit reads like bent cable, its curves stopping short of closing and never swelling or thinning. Outfit also gives Happy Monkey a bold, distinctive partner, since that display face keeps its straight line weight and wide-gapped e.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-plus-jakarta-sans: Happy Monkey brings bold, distinctive display letters with a ruler-straight line, while Plus Jakarta Sans follows in a modern, monoline sans. The two feel precise under a loud top.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-sora: Sora reads as precise and geometric, its curves turning corners without any pressure swell and its c and s held apart. Its plainness lets Happy Monkey be the loud one.
gen-gf-happy-monkey-space-grotesk: Space Grotesk reads neutral and geometric, each glyph a ribbon of constant width with counters that breathe. Shrink Happy Monkey too small and its bold personality fades.
gen-gf-metamorphous-montserrat: Metamorphous opens with commanding, wide-sidebearing letters and a high midline, softly mixing fat and slim strokes. Montserrat's wire-smooth sans line glides beneath it, like a drafting pen.
gen-gf-oxanium-fs-epilogue: Epilogue's tall-bodied sans lowercase, with stubby ascender tips, feels unclamped and curvy on a wire-like skeleton. Oxanium earns its keep big and short, commanding the top.
gen-gf-revalia-switzer: Loose, bold and wide-striding. Switzer's tubular, wire-like sans letters keep c tips well apart, so a long passage would move along smoothly beneath Revalia's expressive heading.
gen-gf-warnes-general-sans: Warnes tapers its ink strokes out before they touch, with no stroke contrast at all and stretched, spacious tracking. General Sans, a clean sans-serif, suits modest sizes underneath.
gen-irish-grover-work-sans: Work Sans is modern and contemporary, with a high mean line. A longer passage would flow easily, its c tips held apart below Irish Grover's sturdy, organic, fun heading.
